description: The UNEP FI Climate Risk Dashboard is an Excel database of climate risk assessment tools offered to financial institutions, covering physical and transition risk. For each tool it records the provider, risk type, reference scenarios, time series and horizons, data and metrics, hazards covered, depth of analysis, impact channels, validation method, asset and geographic coverage, whether it is open source or commercial, update policies and support, and a 2023 piloting sheet reports how 16 vendors assessed physical risk for a common dummy portfolio of assets in agriculture, real estate, transport and oil and gas. The UNEP Finance Initiative Risk Centre's Risk Assessment and Tools Working Group compiles it from vendor surveys; the first version appeared in June 2023 and the file read is the 2024 Q2 update. Coverage is global tool vendors. Format and access: a free workbook download. Licence: not stated; free. Caveats: entries are self-reported by vendors and include contact details, and the dashboard has not been updated since 2024 on the page read. It helps choose hazard exposure and climate adaptation tools for infrastructure asset portfolios. Related catalogue records are the C2ES Physical Risk Toolkit and CLIMADA.
